label: Call Pill
description: An incoming call as a prop: a dark pill (white on a light theme) with an icon, a line that types on word by word, and the two round buttons, decline (red) and accept (green). Optionally one button is pressed at a word anchor. The 'what if your brand joined the conversation' beat of a launch film: an invitation, a request, a conversation starting. Position and size it with the component's box (a wide, short box: the pill is a bar and sizes to it). One per scene.

text.label: The line, 3-7 words; *stars* accent a word (e.g. "What if your *brand* joined")

icon.label: Glyph or emoji at the left (default ?)

at.label: When the pill arrives (scene seconds; default 0.3)

type_at.label: When the first word types on (default: 0.35s after the pill)

word_times.label: Explicit per-word times in scene seconds (word anchors); overrides word_interval

answer.label: Which button is pressed: accept | decline (omit for none)

answer_at.label: When the button is pressed (scene seconds; default: after the last word)

answered_text.label: accept only: the line the pill shows after the press (e.g. "Joined the conversation")

accent_color.label: Color of the *starred* word (default a pink-violet)

hold.label: Seconds before the pill exits (0/omit = stays)

scale.label: Size multiplier for the whole prop
